title: Making AI Companion like Grok AI
author: Ok-Suspect-9855
selftext:
I am just finishing off an ai companion app like Grok companion. Made 20 characters all running real-time on had to make a lot of custom ai things like STT, TTS and facial movement,  model heavily modified character to be able to scale it for many users via CPU. Currently starting promotion giving all 20 companions their own social media testing live streaming for one of them at the moment. [https://kick.com/synthavatar](https://kick.com/synthavatar) hoping they will build their own following and pull in users. before it launches
